deck: Sketchy Pharm::2 Cardiovascular & Renal::2 Diuretics::2.1 - Acetazolamide, mannitol

question.text: Does Mannitol cause hyper or hyponatremia?

answer.text:
Either, depending on situation

(↑ Solute in serum ⇒ ↑ Osmotic draw from ECF ⇒ Dilution and hyponatremia)

(↑ Solute in urine ⇒ ↑ Osmotic draw in tubular fluid ⇒ ↑ Water excretion ⇒ Concentration and hypernatremia)
